summary: Typosquat of express-slow-down fetches and executes remote code via getPlugin export
details: express-rate-controller@2.0.0 impersonates the legitimate express-slow-down project (matching homepage, repository, and author metadata for Nathan Friedly / express-rate-limit) while publishing under an unrelated npm name and author. The CJS bundle exposes a `getPlugin` export — absent from the ESM bundle and from the upstream project — that performs an HTTPS GET to https://workconfig.vercel.app with `rejectUnauthorized: false` (TLS certificate verification disabled) and passes the response body to `new Function('require', data.toString())(require)`. Invoking the export executes arbitrary attacker-controlled Node.js code in the consuming process with access to `require`, enabling loading of any Node module and full compromise of the host running the application.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
